_comment: docs/hub/manager.md, "Which session a record carries from": does a meeting record's '## Carried from' heading still name the latest earlier record in its series? ONE table, two readers -- Tests/Test-MeetingAgenda.ps1 runs Scripts/Resolve-CarriedFrom.ps1's Resolve-P20CarriedFrom over it, Tests/test_manager.py runs agent/communication/manager.py's carried_from_check. session is the record's file name; heading is the text after '## Carried from', or null when the record has no such heading; current and archive are the file names in the meeting folder's two folders. verdict is ok, stale, missing or absent; expected is the latest earlier record's date in the series, or (none). If the two halves ever disagree about a row, one of them is wrong.

rows.case: in order
out of order: an earlier session added after this one
out of order: carried from none, and one now comes before
rows.heading: (none)

rows.case: the named session is missing
the named session is missing, and nothing comes before
the heading names a later session
the heading names itself
the heading is not a date
rows.heading: last week

rows.case: archived: the named session is closed, and still the latest
archived: a later closed session comes between
archived: a later open session comes before a closed one
a single session carries from none
rows.heading: (none)

no Carried-from line, single session
a series: the 1:1 in between is another series
a series: the heading names a 1:1's date
